title: Functions to Scrape Rugby Data
text: R package scrape, clean analyse publicly available rugby league data. Available CRAN. 📖 Full function reference: danieltomaro13.github.io/nrlR

title: Functions to Scrape Rugby Data
text: nrlR gives R users one consistent set functions rugby league data public sources. covers: 🏆 NRL NRLW 🏟️ State Origin 🌏 Super League, Championship, League One, Challenge Cup 🏉 NSW Cup, QLD Cup, Women’s Super League 🔥 Historical seasons back 1998 nrlR can pull: ✅ Match fixtures results, including referees, venues attendance ✅ Ladders home, away total splits ✅ Player team statistics Champion Data, 60+ metrics per player per match ✅ Team lists, injuries suspensions ✅ Venues coaching records Every function returns tidy tibble, ready dplyr, ggplot2 model.
